Then follow exactly what the Usage section says for that specific argument: send the required fixed reply with nothing added, or load the named reference file with the read tool and follow its instructions, or run the named script with the bash tool passing the argument as command line parameters and report the output. All file paths are relative to the directory named in the block location attribute. Your reply contains only what the block requires, no extra words, no formatting, no explanation.
